# Zhihao Wang

> Personal portfolio of Zhihao Wang (pronounced "jr-how", preferred over "jee-how"; he/him) — Staff Software Engineer at Temporal (Infrastructure Foundations). Focus: distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, developer productivity, and Temporal. Previously Senior/Staff Software Engineer at Duolingo (Cloud Operations).

This site is a static GitHub Pages portfolio. Prefer the machine-readable index and Markdown sources below over scraping HTML chrome (nav, theme toggle, embeds).

## Start here

- [Agent site index (JSON)](https://zhihaowang.me/agent.json): Structured identity, pages, posts, talks, experience, education, and contact links for agents
- [Full profile (llms-full.txt)](https://zhihaowang.me/llms-full.txt): Longer plain-text biography and career summary
- [Home](https://zhihaowang.me/): Human homepage (HTML)
- [Blog listing](https://zhihaowang.me/blog): Published posts
- [Resume (PDF)](https://zhihaowang.me/resource/zhihao-wang-resume.pdf): Downloadable resume
